hook.text: You have an index on last_name and another on city. But a query filtering by both is still slow.

buildup.text: A composite index combines multiple columns into one index, ordered left to right.

discovery.text: An index on (last_name, city) efficiently filters by last_name, or last_name AND city — but not city alone.

twist.text: Column order matters enormously. (city, last_name) and (last_name, city) serve completely different queries.

climax.text: Composite indexes are the most underused optimization. Most slow queries can be fixed by the right composite index.

punchline.text: Combine columns in one index — order matters.

quiz.question: Why does column order matter in composite indexes?
options: The index is ordered left to right and can only filter by leftmost columns first
